plate_intro.text: SNS Rent Car · Plate. Screens are grouped by module in the order of the work (01 Start → 15 Settings, then printed documents and system reference). Each screen shows its desktop version, then its phone version beside it. Names follow “module.screen  Name · Device”; file names follow the same pattern (e.g. 05-NewRental-ChooseCar-Phone). Links stay on the same device.

nav_intro.text: Chosen 25 Oct 2026: A, the labelled sidebar. It now runs on every desktop screen (Plate NavRail). B and C are kept for reference. Ideas from real products on Mobbin. A: labelled sidebar grouped by job (Jobber, Shopify). B: five-area rail with a “today, in order” panel (Supabase, Neon). C: top tabs with a search that jumps anywhere (Bonsai, command menus). Sample data.
